endpoint.span: The primary outcome was the incidence of AAD during 2 weeks of follow-up.

estimate.span: The proportion of patients experiencing AAD during follow-up was 19.3% (106/549) in the probiotic group vs 17.9% (103/577) in the placebo group (unadjusted odds ratio 1.10, 95% confidence interval 0.82-1.49, P = 0.53).

ci.span: The proportion of patients experiencing AAD during follow-up was 19.3% (106/549) in the probiotic group vs 17.9% (103/577) in the placebo group (unadjusted odds ratio 1.10, 95% confidence interval 0.82-1.49, P = 0.53).

treatment_strategy.span: A multicentre, double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomized trial was conducted to evaluate the role of Lactobacillus casei DN114001 (combined as a drink with two regular yoghurt bacterial strains) in reducing AAD and Clostridioides difficile infection in patients aged over 55 years.

follow_up.span: The primary outcome was the incidence of AAD during 2 weeks of follow-up.

absent_reason.analysis_set: Neither source explicitly identifies the analysis population for the estimate. 'Both groups were followed up as per protocol.' describes follow-up and does not establish a per-protocol analysis.

served_mismatch: The served arm-level counts match the source. The printed effect and confidence interval are an unadjusted OR, not RR; no RR or RR confidence interval is printed. The served per-protocol analysis label is unsupported, and the requested intention-to-treat population is not established. The source specifies 2 weeks of follow-up.

candidate_rejections.span: Both groups were followed up as per protocol.
candidate_rejections.why: Reject this as evidence for the served per-protocol analysis label: it describes follow-up, not the population used to compute the estimate.
These numbers bind an OR and its confidence interval; they cannot be bound as the requested RR and RR confidence interval.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The entry population is described as patients aged over 55 years, but antibiotic receipt as an entry criterion and intention-to-treat analysis are not explicitly stated.

notes: Bindings use the held abstract; no registry or full text is supplied. Dose and regimen are not stated. The reported randomized total is 1127, whereas the reported arm sizes sum to 1126; no correction is inferred. BOUND applies to the reported OR and arm counts, not an independently reported RR.
